proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.grant_speed
proposed_widenings.justification: Dragon Wings grants a Fly Speed of 60 ft for the duration. ClassFeatureEffect only covers grant_extra_action and heal_hp. The v4 atom modify_speed exists in the taxonomy but is not wired into ClassFeatureEffect. A new variant is needed to carry speed-kind (fly/walk/swim/climb) and the feet value.
proposed_widenings.evidence: For the duration, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence.long_rest_or_spend_resource
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature resets on Long Rest by default, but the player may also restore the use mid-rest by spending 3 Sorcery Points (no action required). This is a two-path reset — Long Rest OR resource expenditure — not expressible by any existing RestResetCadence variant. A new variant carrying the resource kind and point cost is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you spend 3 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

notes: The payload family (class_feature / activation) and activation cost (bonus_action) fit cleanly. The duration (1 hour, dismissible) maps to a timed duration with a dismiss lifecycle atom — but ClassFeatureMechanics has no duration field at all, which is a third implicit gap (the current surface only models always-on effects or instant effects from class features). The two widenings above are the blocking ones; the duration gap is noted as additional surface pressure. No Dhall or JSON content files authored.
